purpose: Conceptual editorial cover; not a quantitative ray trace.

The focal ray paths should be visually coherent and straight between interactions. No words, no letters, no equations, no numeric labels, no logos, no watermark. Landscape aspect ratio approximately 16:9. This is a conceptual cover, not a measurement plot or a literal construction drawing.
